title: A fixed Pauli-norm threshold for diagonal matrix powering
description: For every fixed Pauli coefficient-norm cap above one, distinguishing a single unnormalized basis diagonal of a polynomial matrix power at thresholds 9/32 and 7/32 is PromiseBQP-complete, even with explicitly listed dyadic coefficients and a positive definite contraction. Any estimate accurate to 1/32 decides the reduced instances. At cap one an efficient classical sampler is known. The fixed-error hardness also holds on an open nearest-neighbor chain of 16-dimensional sites with position-dependent interactions and a computational-basis product input.
